cuts.head: with_body
cuts.placeText: a car repair garage — a hydraulic lift, a wall of hanging tools, oil drums and a tire stack
cuts.scene: she is the chief mechanic sitting sideways on a stool, tightening a bolt with a socket wrench held in both hands
cuts.outfit: a mechanic look fitted to her body — an unbuttoned oil-smudged coverall tied at the waist over a fitted tank top and shorts, bare shoulders and legs, a heavy tool-belt with a purple stripe
